== frame outside cursor=11,20
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd project
|denv: loading .envrc
|denv: +EXISTING
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $ echo $EXISTING
|inside
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $ cd ..
|denv: -EXISTING
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ echo $EXISTING
|outside
|
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $
